capabilities: create .nomedia files in the vault, attachment folder, or chosen folders
apply protection automatically when the vault opens on Android
remove plugin-created .nomedia files when protection is disabled
preserve pre-existing .nomedia files at target locations
show notices when protection files are created or removed
extras: Configuration works on any platform, but .nomedia files are only created or removed in Obsidian for Android; the README also warns that some third-party gallery apps may ignore .nomedia and explains how to clear a gallery app's cache so old images disappear.
problem: On Android, gallery and media apps index every image stored inside the Obsidian vault, cluttering the device gallery with note attachments.
summary: Android-focused utility that creates .nomedia files in selected vault folders so gallery apps stop indexing the vault's images.
